subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value:
SCOPE AND STANDING. This is the measured BOUNDARY on claim.law.split-bss-symbols-are-one-record-and-array-form-defeats-synthesized-index-base.20260831.v2 Extension B (declare the record, respell the whole population). Extension B is CONFIRMED, but its payoff is governed by REGION COUNT, not by population size, and the two are not the same thing -- which is why 'convert the whole population' can be satisfied in full and still lose. Read together with claim.law.direct-global-member-flips-index-base-association.20260831.v1, whose PROCEDURE clause anticipated exactly this and is hereby promoted from advice to a gate.

THE RULE. Respelling a raw-offset access population as member/array references into a declared record converges structure ALWAYS (every one of the six functions measured here improved or held its opcode multiset) but converges the SCORE only when one addressing region covers every converted site. A region here is one live base+index value: `base + player*4` and `base + player*256` are two regions even inside one function. Measured, all six over the same record: show_piles, ONE region (a single `base + col*12` group plus two isolated reads), fuzzy 94.0196 -> 97.0588, real 64 -> 60, opcode multiset 4 tokens -> IDENTICAL at an already instruction-count-exact 102/102 -- the whole structural gap closed. show_gold, ONE region, real 127 -> 117, fuzzy 89.3784 -> 89.4459. fn_8009A0AC, ONE region, byte-identical (documentation-only win). do_shopping_8009AA48, THREE regions plus scattered singletons: the full member respelling moved the multiset 23 -> 20 tokens and the instruction count 867 -> 868 against a target of 870 -- both structural instruments improving -- while fuzzy fell 92.2517 -> 91.9885 and real rose 831 -> 848; reverted. write_shop_menu, FOUR regions: two independent conversions (whole-population, and around-the-protected-webs) moved the multiset 16 -> 13 and 16 -> 12 tokens and the count 393 -> 394/395 against 401, while fuzzy fell 90.2968 -> 89.3491 and 89.1596 and real rose 374 -> 391 and 402; both reverted. The pattern is one-directional across five measurements and the cost scales with region count, because each region MWCC must now reach through a symbol-relative displacement is one more base it will not share with its neighbours.

THE GATE, cheap and mandatory before spending a build on this cure: count the target's live base+index groups for the record in the function. One group -> convert, expect a real win. Two or more -> expect the CONFLICT signature (multiset and count parity improve, fuzzy and real regress) and do not spend the conversion on score grounds; it remains valid as a de-fakematch documentation conversion ONLY if it gates byte-identical.

COROLLARY 1, THE ARBITER. This residual class produces genuine metric disagreement in a reproducible direction: the opcode multiset and instruction-count parity say BETTER while fuzzy and real say WORSE, three times out of three on multi-region functions. Do not resolve it from --ops alone and do not resolve it from real alone. objdiff fuzzy from a FRESH full report build is the arbiter, and on all three it agreed with real against the multiset. This bounds claim.law.recomputed-index-array-form-safe.20260831.v2's lesson (2): the multiset is the finer instrument only on a function whose instruction stream is already COUNT-EXACT (show_piles, 102/102, where it was decisive); where the count is still short the multiset can improve while the function gets objectively worse.

COROLLARY 2, CONVERT AROUND PROTECTED WEBS, NOT THROUGH THEM -- and this is what turned the lane's one big win. show_piles's first conversion respelled the ENTIRE population including a `slot += count*4` walked alias, and measured real 64 -> 108 with the instruction count leaving exactness (102 -> 104). The identical conversion with that ONE alias left in its original raw byte-offset form, and only the two unprotected sites converted, measured real 64 -> 60 with the opcode multiset going IDENTICAL. So claim.law.cached-base-alias-defeats-rematerialized-index-base's all-or-nothing prescription and the lwzu/walked-pointer web-retention laws are not in conflict: 'whole population' means every site NOT inside a protected load-update or induction web, and a walked alias is not a cached alias to be deleted but a web to be preserved. Same result at write_shop_menu, where the version that also converted the `joff` accumulator and the `*(scrollflag += 12)` idiom was worse than the version that spared them.

COROLLARY 3, THE EXTERN'S TYPE IS WORTH MORE THAN THE ACCESS SPELLING. Retyping `extern u8 lbl_802897D0[]` to `extern ShopPage lbl_802897D0` improved do_shopping_8009AA48 by itself -- real 831 -> 826, fuzzy 92.2517 -> 92.3667 -- with NO member respelling anywhere in that function, purely by changing what its `u8* page = ...` base local is initialised FROM. That is the opposite of where the effort went, and it was free. Retype the extern first and gate it alone before planning any site edits.

COROLLARY 4, TWO MEASURED NEGATIVES ON NEIGHBOURING LAWS. (a) claim.law.direct-global-member-flips-index-base-association's cell (4), a direct global-symbol member access, is NOT a universal cure: spelled `lbl_802897D0.pile_count[col]` with no local at all, show_gold measured real 121 against 117 for the pointer-local cast form and 127 for `&lbl_802897D0`, and the function's target-only `+3 add` residual was IDENTICAL in all three -- so cell (4) neither flipped the association nor paid here. (b) claim.law.cast-view-macro-reopens-addr-pre-that-member-form-closed is CONFIRMED from the cost side: the `((ShopPage*)page)->field` cast-view spelling gave do_shopping the WORST structural state of any variant tried, 27 multiset tokens against a 23-token baseline and 20 for the named typed local. Name the cast result once; never spell the view inline.

COROLLARY 5, THE CAST NODE THAT MAKES THE RETYPE FREE. After retyping the extern to the record type, a consumer that still wants a record pointer must spell it `(ShopPage*)(u8*)&lbl_802897D0`, not `&lbl_802897D0`: the latter regressed show_gold 117 -> 127 and the former restored 117 exactly, with nothing else changed. This is claim.law.noop-cast-on-array-decay-not-neutral running in the mirror direction -- the intermediate `(u8*)` reproduces the array-to-pointer decay the record's other consumers still see, and the cast node's presence, not the resulting type, is what MWCC schedules from.
